observations.body: Jeremiah breaks a jar in the valley and announces judgment because Judah burned children there, an act God says he did not command or imagine.
observations.label: Topheth exposes child sacrifice as uncommanded

payload.posture: Read Jeremiah 19:1–15 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
